jobs.description:
Onze klant is een hoogtechnologisch bedrijf, een spin-off van de KUL dat fungeert als één van de grootste onderzoekscentra van Europa met verschillende uitdagingen. Onze klant is volop bezig met innovatie. Wil je mee aan de wieg staan qua ontwikkelingen naar artificiële intelligentie, nanotechnologie en ICT toe? Reageer dan snel. Wie weet krijg jij de kans om mee bij te dragen aan de technologie van morgen!

Jobomschrijving

Are you passionate about supply chain operations and ensuring materials are available when and where they are needed? Do you enjoy working with data, planning processes, and cross-functional stakeholders to keep operations running smoothly? Then this temporary opportunity could be the perfect next step in your career.

Your Challenge

As a Supply Chain Assistant, you will play a key role in supporting material planning, inventory management, and supply chain continuity. You will work closely with Procurement, Engineering, Operations, and Supply Chain teams to ensure the availability of critical materials and contribute to the optimization of supply chain processes.

What will you do?
	
• Manage material availability and inventory levels to support uninterrupted operations.	
• Maintain and optimize SAP MRP parameters.	
• Follow up on material shortages, replenishment activities, and planning actions.	
• Collaborate with Supply Chain, Procurement, Engineering, and Operations teams to resolve material-related issues.	
• Monitor and analyze KPIs and SAP reports to identify risks, bottlenecks, and improvement opportunities.	
• Support continuous improvement initiatives related to material planning and supply chain workflows.	
• Contribute to process optimization projects aimed at increasing efficiency and reliability across the supply chain.

Who are we looking for?
	
• Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain Management, Logistics, Business Administration, or a related field.	
• Experience with SAP, MRP planning, and inventory management processes.	
• Strong analytical skills and advanced knowledge of Excel.	
• Fluent communication skills in English, both written and spoken.	
• Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills.	
• Proactive, solution-oriented, and able to work independently.	
• Strong attention to detail with a results-driven mindset.	
• Previous experience within the semiconductor industry is considered a strong asset.

jobs.occupation: ACCOUNTS RECEIVABLE & CREDIT SPECIALIST - BX - FOOD SECTOR

•

High accuracy and attention to detail in work, especially in record-keeping

Strong critical thinking skills to support precise and efficient operations

jobs.occupation: Environmental Health & Safety Advisor - Healthcare - part-time
jobs.description:
Our client is a global healthcare technology organization operating in a highly regulated and mission-driven environment. They are looking for an EHS Specialist to support employees across Belgium and the wider Benelux region. Acting as Prevention Advisor, you will ensure compliance, promote a strong safety culture, and bridge corporate EHS standards with local regulatory requirements.

Jobomschrijving

• Act as Prevention Advisor for the Belgian commercial organization

• Implement and maintain EHS policies, procedures, and programs
• Lead initiatives related to ergonomics, driver safety, fire safety, PPE, and employee health

jobs.occupation: EMEA Sales Manager - Specialty Polymers & Elastomer Materials
jobs.description:
The role focuses on managing and developing relationships with large international customers across the industrial materials sector.

Jobomschrijving

As a Sales Manager your responsibilities are:

• Develop and execute sales strategies to achieve business objectives.
• Manage and grow key accounts, ensuring long-term relationships with clients.
• Identify market opportunities and devise plans to capitalise on them.
• Monitor sales performance and analyse data to improve results.
• Collaborate with internal teams to align sales strategies with company goals.
• Lead and motivate the sales team to achieve individual and collective targets.
• Prepare and present regular sales reports to senior management.
• Stay updated on retail market trends and competitor activities.

A successful Sales Manager should have:

• 10+ years of experience in sales and business development.
• Proven success managing international and global key accounts.
• Strong background in specialty materials, raw materials, polymers, plastics, compounding, or related industrial sectors.
• Experience within the TPE/TPC/SBC market is highly desirable.
• Demonstrated ability to develop business and grow strategic customer relationships.
• Strong commercial acumen, negotiation skills, and ability to close complex deals.
• Fluent English (written and verbal).
• Comfortable working within a multicultural and international environment.
• Highly autonomous, self-motivated, and capable of working independently.
• Willingness to travel extensively across the region.

The client is an international engineering and industrial project partner delivering modularized systems, skids, and integrated technical solutions for demanding industrial and data center environments.

Jobomschrijving

• Design and document LV/MV electrical systems, including single-line diagrams, cabling, cable routing, layouts, grounding, lighting, transformers, switchgear, busbars, UPS systems, emergency generators, electrical tracing, and other associated equipment.
• Develop and maintain electrical and instrumentation documentation, including equipment datasheets and specifications, cable schedules, material take-offs, I/O lists, loop diagrams, hook-up drawings, junction box documentation, communication cable lists, and functional analyses.
• Manage the instrumentation scope, including the selection and integration of pressure, temperature, level and flow instruments, analyzers, control valves, on/off valves, remote I/O, fire & gas detection systems, and related equipment.
• Coordinate technical interfaces with piping, mechanical, structural, automation, workshop, and procurement teams, ensuring that electrical and instrumentation designs are compatible with modular construction, assembly, testing, and site installation requirements.
• Support technical procurement and project execution by reviewing supplier quotations, leading technical clarification meetings, preparing technical bid comparisons, validating process data, supporting workshop configuration, and ensuring documentation, traceability, QA/QC, and applicable standards are respected.

• Industrial Engineer with a minimum of 5 years of experience in E&I engineering within an industrial environment such as oil & gas, pharmaceuticals, energy, manufacturing, or data centers.
• Strong technical expertise in electrical engineering and instrumentation, including LV/MV systems, industrial electrical equipment, instrumentation, cabling, control systems, and associated engineering documentation.
• Good knowledge of industrial communication protocols and control architectures, including HART, Modbus RTU, PROFIBUS, PROFINET, OPC UA, ESD systems, process control systems, and SIL principles in accordance with IEC 61508 and IEC 61511.
• Fluent in English and French

An international technology company operating in the media sector is looking for an Information Security Engineer to join the IT Security team within the corporate IT department. The role focuses on operational cybersecurity activities, vulnerability management, security monitoring, incident response support, security assessments, and continuous improvement of security controls.

This is a hands-on role combining technical expertise, operational follow-up, coordination, and continuous improvement. The position is part of a structured cybersecurity and compliance programme in the context of NIS2 obligations under Belgian law and the implementation of ISO/IEC 27001:2022 certification, with a target of April 2027. The consultant/employee will contribute directly to control implementation, evidence production, and audit readiness across the corporate IT perimeter.

Practical information

 
• Location: Seraing (Liège), Belgium
 
• Contract type: open to freelance consultant or permanent employee, depending on profile
 
• Start date: as soon as possible
 
• Remote work: hybrid model with 2 days per week remote and 3 days on site
 
• Travel: no travel required
 
• Reporting line: Cybersec Operations Manager
 
• Working language: French for day-to-day team interactions, with professional English required for documentation, tools, and international stakeholders
 
• Team context: the IT Security team is being structured and scaled, in a build environment rather than a steady-state operation

Main responsibilities

Security operations & monitoring:

 
• Monitor and investigate security alerts across multiple security platforms
 
• Participate in incident response activities and support the coordination of security investigations
 
• Improve and tune detection capabilities and monitoring use cases
 
• Support the development and maintenance of operational security procedures and playbooks
 
• Perform operational security reviews and follow-up activities

Vulnerability & exposure management:

 
• Coordinate vulnerability scanning activities and ensure findings are reviewed and prioritized
 
• Follow up remediation actions with infrastructure, platform, application, and support teams
 
• Track remediation progress and escalate overdue actions when required
 
• Coordinate external penetration tests and security assessments
 
• Ensure findings from assessments and pentests are documented, tracked, and remediated

Security assessments & risk management:

 
• Perform security reviews of applications, services, and technical solutions
 
• Contribute to risk assessments for new projects, technologies, and providers
 
• Review security configurations and identify improvement opportunities
 
• Support the identification and management of security risks across the IT environment

Security governance & reporting:

 
• Maintain and monitor operational security KPIs and dashboards
 
• Support reporting related to vulnerabilities, incidents, security posture, and remediation efforts
 
• Participate in periodic reviews of user access, privileged accounts, and security controls
 
• Contribute to compliance activities and implementation of security requirements related to ISO/IEC 27001:2022 and NIS2
 
• Produce and maintain auditable evidence of security control operations, including logs, reports, review records, and remediation closure evidence

Security improvement & automation:

 
• Identify opportunities to improve security controls and operational processes
 
• Contribute to...
...

Experience:

• Minimum 3 years of experience in cybersecurity, security operations, vulnerability management, or a related technical security role

• Experience in security monitoring, incident handling, or vulnerability management

• Experience working with security tools and operational security processes

 

Technical knowledge:

• Understanding of security monitoring and incident response principles

• Knowledge of vulnerability management processes and risk-based remediation prioritization, including CVSS scores, asset criticality, exploitability context, and compensating controls

• Hands-on experience with Microsoft Defender XDR suite: Defender for EndPoint, Defender for Office 365 / Exchange Online Protection, and Defender for Identity

• Familiarity with Microsoft Sentinel or an equivalent SIEM platform; deployment experience is a strong asset

• Understanding of Entra ID governance, including Conditional Access, Identity Protection, and Privileged Identity Management (PIM)

• Familiarity with Microsoft Intune and Microsoft Purview

• Understanding of network security fundamentals, including Firewall management with Palo Alto or FortiGate, log forwarding, and network segmentation principles

• Familiarity with security frameworks and best practices such as ISO/IEC 27001, NIST CSF, and CIS Controls

 

Personal skills:

• Strong analytical and problem-solving mindset

• Organized, structured, and detail-oriented

• Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with different teams

• Curious, proactive, and willing to continuously learn new technologies and security trends

• Strong communication and coordination skills

• Practical and solution-oriented team player

 

Languages:

• Fluent French

• Professional English required

 

Nice to have certifications

• SC-200 — Microsoft Security Operations Analyst

• SC-300 — Microsoft Identity and Access Administrator

• CompTIA Security+ or Cysa+

• ISO/IEC 27001 Lead Implementer or Lead Auditor

Are you ready for a challenging career in the FAB Engineering team? Would you like to work with the most high-tech devices? Then read on quickly!

As an Equipment Maintenance Engineer, you'll start your journey in the esteemed FAB Engineering team:

• You'll get hands-on experience with the high-tech process equipment in our cleanroom. No need to be an expert from day one – we'll give you the time to thoroughly understand these cutting-edge tools. The team takes pride in maintaining and fine-tuning some of the most advanced equipment globally. You'll even get a chance to work with first versions and prototypes, which is pretty exciting!
• You will work closely with equipment manufacturers and other process engineers, so you'll be collaborating with a diverse group of experts.
• You’ll be part of the FAB Engineering team that consists of over 100 talented individuals with whom you will form the beating heart of our research institute. Specializing in nano-electronics, your work will contribute to technological solutions in various fields like healthcare and energy.

• You hold a Master's degree in Industrial Science with a focus on Electromechanics or Mechanics, or you have acquired equivalent technical experience. If you're just starting out, that's perfectly fine! We welcome motivated beginners who are eager to launch their careers.
• You are genuinely passionate about technology and equipment, and you are not afraid to work hands-on. Your technical knowledge of pneumatics, pumps, motors, electronics, and (electro)mechanics is a valuable asset.
• We highly appreciate your collaborative spirit, while also trusting your ability to proactively plan and organize your work on your own.
• You have a very good knowledge of English.
You will work in a shift regime: early - late (6u-14u & 14u-22u) and 1 weekend every 3 weeks

As a production worker, you will work together with a colleague every day to manufacture safety boots 👢. You will place components such as the steel toe cap, lining and sole into the mould. The machine automatically injects the plastic, after which you remove the finished boot. In between production runs, you clean the machine to ensure it is ready for the next production cycle.

After training, you will also be able to operate other machines. You will cut away larger excess pieces and trim fine seams ✂️. You will carry out quality checks and pay close attention to detail. Every boot must meet strict quality standards. With your keen eye for detail, you make sure that only top-quality products leave the facility.

Working together with your colleagues is important. You step in where needed and support each other in achieving the production targets. You work accurately and take pride in the end result. Are you eager to learn and quality-focused? Then this could be the opportunity for you! ✅

Sound like the job for you? Apply now and discover how you can make a difference!

Who are we looking for?

• You have some initial stable experience in a production environment ⚙️
• You speak English well; Dutch is a plus.
• You have your own means of transportation (public transport is not available).
• You are attentive and have an eye for detail. 👀
• You can work at a fast pace and are physically fit. 💪
• You are not afraid of physically demanding work.
